investigation_notes.Description: Multiple high-entropy DNS A queries to dotnxdomain.net with unusually large payloads (574 bytes vs typical 28 bytes) were observed from dc-prod-02 (10.150.22.41) to an external IP. Query names contain long encoded tokens and 'root-key-sentinel' strings consistent with DNS tunneling or a covert channel. Because the source is a production domain controller and the traffic is anomalous, externally directed, and structurally indicative of tunneling, this activity is considered High Priority and requires further investigation.
